units.rawText: Yup!

units.rawText: This place is...

units.rawText: It's the reactor control room. There's one in each reactor, at the very top of each building.
units.displayText: It's the reactor control room. There's one in each reactor, at the very top of each building.

spans.text: It's the reactor control room. There's one in each reactor, at the very top of each building.

units.rawText: It wouldn't be so bad normally, but I really didn't know how to get here with the Entropics trapping us.
units.displayText: It wouldn't be so bad normally, but I really didn't know how to get here with the Entropics trapping us.

spans.text: It wouldn't be so bad normally, but I really didn't know how to get here with the Entropics trapping us.

units.rawText: You did good, Mini-Robot. When I get back, I'll give you a commendation to the Sector Administrator.
units.displayText: You did good, Mini-Robot. When I get back, I'll give you a commendation to the Sector Administrator.

spans.text: You did good, Mini-Robot. When I get back, I'll give you a commendation to the Sector Administrator.

units.rawText: Er... It doesn't look like it wants to bother you now...
units.displayText: Er... It doesn't look like it wants to bother you now...

spans.text: Er... It doesn't look like it wants to bother you now...

units.rawText: Actually, my original plan was to have it fly us back to the Admin Center, but now that I look at it, this works too.
units.displayText: Actually, my original plan was to have it fly us back to the Admin Center, but now that I look at it, this works too.

spans.text: Actually, my original plan was to have it fly us back to the Admin Center, but now that I look at it, this works too.

units.rawText: Ahem, well, the plan you have in your head is always bolder than the one that actually gets carried out. Don't worry, I'll give you chocolate later.
units.displayText: Ahem, well, the plan you have in your head is always bolder than the one that actually gets carried out. Don't worry, I'll give you chocolate later.

spans.text: Ahem, well, the plan you have in your head is always bolder than the one that actually gets carried out. Don't worry, I'll give you chocolate later.

units.rawText: But, what did we come here for?
units.displayText: But, what did we come here for?

spans.text: But, what did we come here for?

units.rawText: There's no comms gear here... And we're still trapped inside the reactor.
units.displayText: There's no comms gear here... And we're still trapped inside the reactor.

spans.text: There's no comms gear here... And we're still trapped inside the reactor.

units.rawText: Do you know who modified this reactor?
units.displayText: Do you know who modified this reactor?

spans.text: Do you know who modified this reactor?

units.rawText: Hm? If I'm not wrong, it was the Professor and Miss Croque...
units.displayText: Hm? If I'm not wrong, it was the Professor and Miss Croque...

spans.text: Hm? If I'm not wrong, it was the Professor and Miss Croque...

units.rawText: Correct. And Croque left behind lots of prefab parts from the Oasis' Engineering Department back then.
units.displayText: Correct. And Croque left behind lots of prefab parts from the Oasis' Engineering Department back then.

spans.text: Correct. And Croque left behind lots of prefab parts from the Oasis' Engineering Department back then.

units.rawText: And everything made in the Oasis uses prefab components. In other words, as long as you know how to do it...
units.displayText: And everything made in the Oasis uses prefab components. In other words, as long as you know how to do it...

spans.text: And everything made in the Oasis uses prefab components. In other words, as long as you know how to do it...

units.rawText: We can use the tools and parts here to fix anything made by the Oasis!
units.displayText: We can use the tools and parts here to fix anything made by the Oasis!

spans.text: We can use the tools and parts here to fix anything made by the Oasis!

units.rawText: But what do we have to fix that's made in the Oasis... huh?

units.displayText: Helix realizes that Banxsy is pointing at her with one finger, and she can't help but look where the finger is pointing.

spans.text: Helix realizes that Banxsy is pointing at her with one finger, and she can't help but look where the finger is pointing.

units.rawText: So you mean...
units.displayText: So you mean...

spans.text: So you mean...

units.rawText: Bingo! I want to fix your DNA analyzer!
units.displayText: Bingo! I want to fix your DNA analyzer!

spans.text: Bingo! I want to fix your DNA analyzer!

units.rawText: That way, you can give me the proper treatment, right?
units.displayText: That way, you can give me the proper treatment, right?

spans.text: That way, you can give me the proper treatment, right?

units.rawText: Well, that's true... But do you know how to fix it, Banxsy?
units.displayText: Well, that's true... But do you know how to fix it, Banxsy?

spans.text: Well, that's true... But do you know how to fix it, Banxsy?

units.rawText: I'm Banxsy the Almighty, you know. What's so strange about being able to fix a piece of machinery?
units.displayText: I'm Banxsy the Almighty, you know. What's so strange about being able to fix a piece of machinery?

spans.text: I'm Banxsy the Almighty, you know. What's so strange about being able to fix a piece of machinery?

units.displayText: Good thing I studied up before coming here...

spans.text: Good thing I studied up before coming here...

units.rawText: In any case, let me give it a try.
units.displayText: In any case, let me give it a try.

spans.text: In any case, let me give it a try.

units.displayText: There we go! It's done!

spans.text: There we go! It's done!

units.rawText: How about it? Wanna turn it on and see?
units.displayText: How about it? Wanna turn it on and see?

spans.text: How about it? Wanna turn it on and see?

units.rawText: Wow!! This... It actually started up!!
units.displayText: Wow!! This... It actually started up!!

units.rawText: Um... But... how come the outer shell looks different from before?
units.displayText: Um... But... how come the outer shell looks different from before?

spans.text: Um... But... how come the outer shell looks different from before?

units.rawText: Ehhh... It's just a difference in craftsmanship, don't sweat the small stuff!
units.displayText: Ehhh... It's just a difference in craftsmanship, don't sweat the small stuff!

spans.text: Ehhh... It's just a difference in craftsmanship, don't sweat the small stuff!

units.rawText: I mean, even if the same artist does two pieces of street art with the same theme, the result won't be entirely the same, right?
units.displayText: I mean, even if the same artist does two pieces of street art with the same theme, the result won't be entirely the same, right?

spans.text: I mean, even if the same artist does two pieces of street art with the same theme, the result won't be entirely the same, right?

units.rawText: That, that's true...
units.displayText: That, that's true...

spans.text: That, that's true...

units.rawText: No, wait, only Miss Lancet and Miss Anna ought to know how to build this analyzer.
units.displayText: No, wait, only Miss Lancet and Miss Anna ought to know how to build this analyzer.

spans.text: No, wait, only Miss Lancet and Miss Anna ought to know how to build this analyzer.

units.rawText: But after you fixed it, the position of the buttons is exactly the same as the original...
units.displayText: But after you fixed it, the position of the buttons is exactly the same as the original...

spans.text: But after you fixed it, the position of the buttons is exactly the same as the original...

units.rawText: Guh—
units.displayText: Guh—

spans.text: Guh—

units.rawText: Could it be that you asked Miss Lancet or Miss Antonina about it... But we can't contact the outside world now, can we...

spans.text: Could it be that you asked Miss Lancet or Miss Antonina about it... But we can't contact the outside world now, can we...

units.displayText: Girl, you're so sharp it makes me feel so awkward sometimes.

units.rawText: Huh? What does that mean?

units.displayText: Helix tilts her head as she approaches Banxsy.

units.displayText: Um... Ahem... Ah... Er—

spans.text: Um... Ahem... Ah... Er—

units.rawText: I, uh... I was still hurt when I reached the Helios Sector, so I was bored and... I talked to Lancet, and we just so happened to talk about this little thingy of yours. And then we talked about the principles behind it, and I guess it just stuck in my head.

spans.text: And the reason why you suddenly ran over to the Helios Sector to carry out an assignment was also because...

units.rawText: (Coughs) Please keep your headcanon in check. You're reading too much into it.
